html:
Greetings, Agents!

 

CM Fragment of the MARVEL Future Fight Team reporting in!    
    
The Merc with the Mouth Deadpool has created his own mercenary group and is ready to shake MARVEL Future Fight to its core!
Make sure to try out our latest World Boss Mode in November using the <Mercs for Money> team!
Here's the scoop on the November Update! Enjoy!    
    
3 new characters have been added! The new mercenaries Slapstick, Gorilla-Man, and Negasonic Teenage Warhead have arrived!
4 new Uniforms have been added to support the mutants with their activities!
11 characters will have their potential unlocked to strengthen their abilities!
The immortal mutant has returned wielding Celestial power! Apocalypse has received his Tier-3 upgrade!    


A new World Boss Ultimate Difficulty for Cable and Apocalypse has been added!
We've also added Conquer Level System and made improvements to World Boss!
Improvements were made to Dimension Mission to help you complete your missions efficiently!
Make your characters even stronger with new Comic Cards and C.T.P.s!
Other improvements include Alliance Chat improvements, Store UI improvements, and the addition of new Ranking categories!

 

▣ 3 New Characters

 

The Mercs for Money Mercenary Corps has arrived!
Splastick, Gorilla-Man, and Negasonic Teenage Warhead have entered the fray...

 

* New Characters’ Skills are based on Level 1 stats.

 

▣ 4 New Uniforms

 

We've given these mutants new Uniforms to further enhance their power!
Enjoy playing with these mutants using their new Uniforms and check out their new powers and skills!
Deadpool, Cable, Apocalypse, and Domino Uniforms have entered the game.

 

* The new Uniforms added with the November update will sold at a 50% discount to celebrate Black Friday, further details will be announced in the future.
* Uniform Skills are based on Level 1 stats.
* The 4 new uniforms can be purchased in the MARVEL Universe or the Uniform Room and will be available even after the event period ends.


▣ 11 More Characters Can Now Realize Their Potential and 1 can advance to Tier-3

 

Slapstick, Gorilla-Man, Negasonic Teenage Warhead, Bullseye, Green Goblin, Punisher, Carnage, Phil Coulson, Kingpin, Warwolf, and Apocalypse will have their Potentials opened and will be able to reach level 70 after the November Update.

 

Apocalypse can now reach level 70!
The immortal mutant super villain, Apocalypse has acquired new abilities thanks to receiving a Tier-3 upgrade!
 

 

 

 

▣ A New Special Training Package in Danger Room!

Take advantage of this chance to recruit Tier-2 Negasonic Teenage Warhead faster!
A new Special Training Package is available in Danger Room for this new Character!
Purchase this Special Training Package and complete Quests to receive a Tier-2 Character, 1250 Crystals, and growth materials!

- After purchasing this package, you will receive a 6★ Character and Special Training Quests will become available immediately, therefore you will not be able to refund this package once purchased.
- This product will be available until 2020/1/25 3:00 PM (UTC+0), 2020/1/25 7:00 AM (PST) and may be sold again in the future.

 

*The Special Training Quest can only be used to receive rewards for 60 days from the day of purchase.

 

 

 * Complete all of the Special Training Quests to receive all of the rewards above!


▣ New Ultimate difficulties for Cable and Apocalypse

 

Prepare yourselves for grueling Ultimate Difficulty battles in the Cable and Apocalypse World Boss levels. 
The Ultimate Difficulty level for these two has arrived with the November update!
Battle against their new abilities and patterns using your most powerful Characters to defeat them and earn Tier-3 materials!

 

 

▣ World Boss Improvements

Added new Ultimate difficulty and Conquer rewards!

Fight and defeat the bosses using your newly acquired powers and skills!
 

1. New Conquer Rewards for each World Boss

Earn a set amount of Conquer points every time you clear each World Boss. You will receive Conquer Rewards based on the your Conquer Level.

The list of Conquer Levels and their rewards can be found through the World Boss main screen or the World Boss Level info window. Tap on the magnifying glass icon to view the list.

 

 

 


- The Conquer Level is used separately for each World Boss and the points cannot be reset.
- Conquer Rewards can only be claimed once.

 

There are two types of Conquer Rewards:
-Item rewards for increasing your Conquer Level
-Valor rewards for reaching certain Conquer Levels

 

After clearing a World Boss, you can check the rewards that you've earned in the results pop-up window.
 


 - Valor stats are permanently increased when earning Valor reward.
 - Chest and Selector rewards will be sent directly to the Inbox.
 - Defeating a higher difficulty level World Boss or Today's World Boss will reward you with more Conquer Level Exp.

 

2. Added a "Potential" filter that can sort characters by who can have their Potential unlocked.


3. The old World Boss Challenge Info has been separated into the World Boss Level Info tab and the World Boss Challenge Record tab.

- World Boss Level Information
Here you can check the Raid Level, Character Bonus, and Conquer level for each of the World Boss

 

- World Boss Challenge Record
You can check the World Boss Challenge Record ranking for each World Boss and your ranking here.

 


▣ Dimension Mission has been improved!

We've made various changes to Dimension Mission's interface to help improve your playing experience and efficiency.
Experience the improved Dimension Mission now!
 

1. We've added the option in Dimension Mission main screen to view all the available rewards for every day of the week in advance.

 

- You can find out more details about the rewards by tapping on the magnifying glass button.
     

2. As the difficulty level increases, the new rewards that you newly obtained are now easier to identify.
- New rewards that were not available on the previous difficulty will be listed as “new”


3. Selecting a specific Dimension Mission difficulty via the item acquire "Location" screen will automatically move to the specified difficulty level of the Dimension Mission.


4. The Contribution Guide pop-up will now display your Contribution Rewards based on your current Agent Level.

 


5. When using the Support Shop, it will now display the purchase limit for each item and the current amount of that item stored in your Inventory.

 

- Only items that are stored in the Inventory will have the option to view the current count.

 

6. If you don’t have Clear Tickets, you can tap on the "+" button to immediately purchase Clear Tickets.

 

 

7. The Dimension Mission thumbnails will change based on the day's theme. 

 

8. If you acquired the Contribution Reward and the S.H.I.E.L.D Support Package is active, a production effect will display scaling to the amount of rewards you acquired.

 

9. If you acquire a 6★ or higher reward from the Support Shop, it will now be announced in the Chat window.

 

10. You can check your character information under the Rank Up Materials tab in the Support Shop.

 

▣ New Comic Cards and C.T.P.

 

Increase the stats of all of your Characters using the newly added Comic Cards!
Plus, enhance your Characters using the new C.T.P. that came with the November update to make your Characters stronger and more powerful!

 

[Future Fight Firsts]


- The Future Fight Firsts Comic Cards can be obtained from the Comic Card Chest found in the Store.
- When all 3 Future Fight Firsts Comic Cards reached Mythical level and the Card Collection is completed, Attack Speed is increased by +3%.

 

※The stats shown are based on 6★ Rank 7.


[C.T.P. of Judgment, C.T.P. of Greed, and C.T.P. of Insight]

 

- The 3 new C.T.P. can be obtained from [Store] > [Dimension Chest] > [Custom Gear Chest].

 

*The stats shown above are based on the maximum number of option stats.

 

▣ Added New Uniform Collection Mercs for Money

 

To celebrate the arrival of Deadpool's <Mercs for Money> with our November Update,
we've added a new Uniform Collection that will showcase their great looks!

 

Complete your Uniform Collection with the Mercs for Money Uniform Collection and receive rewards!


- Complete the Uniform Collection within certain period to receive additional special rewards.

 

▣ Other Game Improvements 

 

1. Improved the Ranking System UI and added new categories.

- New Ranking System have been added to help Agents view which Comic Cards are frequently used by other Agents.

 

 

- New Ranking System have been added to help Agents to view ISO-8 Set Bonus Effect (8 Set) and C.T.P.  that are frequently used for each character.

 

 

 

2. The Store UI has been improved.
-  We've sorted the Shop into Main and Sub categories and rearranged them to make it easier for our Agents to use.


3. You can now see how many battles are remaining before entering the World Event.


4. Added the search by name function in Marvel Universe and Uniform.

 

 

5. Added the <Agents of Atlas> Theme Uniform logo in the Uniform Collection.

 

6. The Alliance Chat store duration has been increased and improvements have been made to clarify checking a friends and Alliance members access time.

 

 - Up to 300 lines of Alliance Chat will now be stored for up to 60 days. 

- An actively playing friend's access time has been improved to be renewed and displayed as the current time.

 

7. The Agent Badge Enhancement Notifications (Red Dots) have been improved!

 

- You will be notified when you have more Agent Enhancement Kit than the required amount of Agent Tokens for use for Agent Enhancement Kit.


▣ Other Game Error Fixes

 

1. Items stored in the Inbox will now display the item store period in "Days" if the item’s storage period is remain 30 days or longer. 
2. Fixed an issue wherein Characters were moved to an unusual location if the Exclusive Skill Tornado was used in Danger Room.
3. Fixed an issue wherein the next button was not displayed when playing in Shadowland, preventing Agents from progressing.
4. Fixed an issue wherein its possible to have two Io appear if Crescent uses her Skill #5 “Explosive Flying Strike” while the Lifestyle Series 1> Uniform is equipped.
5. Fixed an issue wherein an error code occurred when users attempted to connect to the Game Center on an iOS device.
6. The game will no longer support iOS devices with iOS 8.x or lower.
    If your device uses iOS 8.x or lower, please update the device to the latest version.
7. Fixed an issue wherein some characters are not show properly during Cutscenes in Legendary Battle: Infinity War.
8. Added a missing description in Sword Master <Modern> Tier-2 Skill tooltip.
Added: Enhances effect of skill, Berserk(Passive Skill)
9. Improvement had been made wherein the debuffs that applies to other World Boss will also be applied to Scarlet Witch World Boss Ultimate difficulty when Scarlet Witch uses certain patterns.
10. The effect of Whiplash’s <MARVEL’s Iron Man 2> Active skill # 3 effect color has been changed to blue.
11. Fixed an issue where the effects of C.T.P. of Veteran and C.T.P. of Regeneration are not removed by Cancel and Incapacitation.

 

The November update is coming soon with a lot of big things in store for our Heroes and Mutants!
Be sure to ready your preparations in order to quickly make them more powerful!
Please look forward to more exciting news in the future!
 

Thank you!
